name: pizza-dough-calculator
description: Intelligent Pizza Dough Calculator & Formula Engine with dynamic flour matching, baker percentages, and interactive timelines.

scripts.start: node -e "const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'),m={'.html':'text/html','.js':'text/javascript','.css':'text/css','.json':'application/json'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{let p=q.url.split('?')[0];if(p==='/')p='/index.html';let f=path.join(__dirname,p);fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);s.end('Not found');return;}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':m[path.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d);});}).listen(3000,()=>console.log('🍕 Pizza Dough Calculator running at http://localhost:3000/'));"
scripts.deploy: git add . && git commit -m "Update pizza calculator" && git push origin main
